items.title: Free Art Nouveau Wave Swirl DXF Panel for Laser Cutting
items.description: Flowing Art Nouveau curves sweep across the panel in layered waves, punctuated by a small crescent moon and star accent near the center and framed with crosshatched grid corners. The organic, hand-drawn movement of the swirls contrasts sharply with the rigid grid patches, creating strong visual tension.
